# SEO and Data Checklist: Service subpages for sugaring and brow permanent makeup

**Purpose**: проверить качество требований к новым страницам (заголовочная часть, языковые альтернативы, каннибализация с категориями, JSON-LD), к модели цены пастой и к правкам действующих контрактов и тестов — до `/speckit-tasks`.
**Created**: 2026-10-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are head requirements (title form, description length, canonical, hreflang set, og locales) specified for every one of the four new addresses? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK002 Is the response for English subpage addresses and for the rejected flat addresses (`/sugaring/`, `/powder-brows/`) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Gap]
- [x] CHK003 Are JSON-LD requirements for subpages complete — service, offers by the page's price method, three-level breadcrumb, provider link? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, §FR-004a]
- [x] CHK004 Is the list of living contracts that must change enumerated, including every place that states the page count «пятнадцать»? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK005 Are validation rules for the sugar price field (allowed groups, forbidden price kind) stated as requirements, not only in the data model? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK006 Is it specified whether existing links into the category (gallery cards, services overview) change to point at the subpages? [Completeness, Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the forbidden query in category titles defined as the subpage's query phrase rather than a bare word, so that «ламінування брів» on `beauty` is not caught? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK008 Is «текстовый блок не повторяется» defined with a unit that can be compared (paragraph, list item)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Is it stated whether the sugar price must be of the same kind as the base price of the item? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK010 Is the position of the category's link to its subpage specified, or deliberately left to the text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are the target queries consistent between spec §FR-007/§FR-009/§FR-010, data-model §Target query and the current page-head table for `en`? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK012 Is the hreflang exception for subpages consistent between spec §FR-012, plan §Complexity Tracking and the page-head contract that requires three languages? [Consistency, Conflict]
- [x] CHK013 Do the language-switcher requirement and its edge case describe the same behaviour as the rest of the site? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Is every edge case consistent with the price model — in particular, does any edge case refer to a translatable field the sugar price does not have? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Can SC-003 (category no longer holds the subpage query) be evaluated mechanically on the built pages? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Does SC-007 define which Search Console queries count, so that brow lamination queries of `beauty` do not satisfy it? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK017 Is the sugar-price branch (own price, «not done with paste») covered by an acceptance criterion that real data, which has no sugar prices today, can still exercise? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a price group that becomes empty on the sugaring page? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Is the minimum category text volume after the handover stated as a requirement with a number? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Is behaviour specified when interview answers arrive for some questions but not others? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK021 Is the dependency of package 005 on the new price field documented with the specific requirement it affects? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK022 Is the order dependency «subpages exist in the build → `/seo core` and `/seo map` update» stated? [Dependency, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK023 Is the assumption that depilation prices are shared between wax and paste marked as unverified, with the place where it would be corrected? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
